newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PORTSMOUTH HOPE FOR AUSSIE ASSISTANCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTSMOUTH HOPE FOR AUSSIE ASSISTANCE.

text.p: The manager of English first division club Portsmouth, Terry Fenwick, is hoping the appointment of Terry Venables as the new coach of the Australian national team can bring his club an influx of fresh playing talent.
Venables, who has also become chairman a of Portsmouth, is confident he can handle the demanding dual role of helping the Socceroos' to the 1998 World Cup finals and heading the English club.
Fenwick said: "Terry is very keen for the people of Portsmouth to know that his involvement with the club isn't some fly-by-night thing. He wants to work with the club for a long time to come.
"Being chairman of Portsmouth and manager of the Australian side allows him to have the best of both worlds.
"In many ways this might even help Pompey. You never know, we might end up with a few Aussie players on our books if Terry thinks they are right for us.," he added."
